properties.name: Barapullah drain catchment, South Delhi
properties.note: Corridor around the Kushak Nallah and Barapulla Nala drain system of South and Central Delhi, from the colony drains of R K Puram, Green Park and Chirag Delhi down past Lodhi Colony, Jangpura and Nizamuddin to the outfall into the Yamuna at Sarai Kale Khan. The eastern edge is held west of the Yamuna itself so the river does not dominate the network.
